fishing: WHEN: Thu Oct 29 NE winds easing; fish sheltered Lemon Bay / passes early or protected spots. PASSES-BEACH: redfish near Stump Pass / Englewood on live shrimp or gold spoons; pompano in surf as waters cool; some snook/whiting off beach. LEMON BAY: strong redfish, snook, trout around docks, mangroves, oyster bars, flats; mangrove snapper at piers; sheepshead good. NEARSHORE: limited by prior wind; Spanish mackerel / mangrove snapper / cobia 40-50 ft when conditions allow; offshore mostly shut. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, weedless gold spoons, popping cork. Sources: Waterline / Fishin Franks / Capt. Roger (Oct 27), FL Sportsman SW (Capt. Stamper redfish top vote).
redtide: FWC Oct 23: K. brevis at background concentrations offshore Lee County. Bloom concentrations (>100k cells/L) first this season in 2 samples NW FL St. Joseph Bay (Gulf Co). No SWFL fish kills or respiratory irritation near Englewood/Manasota. Next report Oct 30.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD ~10 CFU/100mL (DOH Charlotte Healthy Beaches, latest samples early-mid Oct). No advisory. Manasota Key / Palm Island / Boca Grande similar good status.
fpl: Charlotte ~2, Sarasota ~149 outages (minor/isolated per trackers); small only, no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
